content:
It's time to take a look together at our curated recommendations for the latest iPhone 18 Pro cases. Apple has launched a new round of Silicone and TechWoven cases, with colourways that perfectly complement the iPhone, alongside all our long-time favourite third-party brands. From the new wine-red model with a built-in kickstand, to slim-fit customisable designs, to premium leather cases from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods, there's something for everyone. We've also found plenty of high-value options from budget-friendly brands like Spigen, starting from US$14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro case recommendations

Updated 27 September: This article has added multiple exclusive discount codes for 9to5 readers.

Apple

  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Mulberry Purple: US$59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Chambray Blue: US$59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Silicone Case with MagSafe — Wine Red: US$49
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Silicone Case with MagSafe — Navy Blue: US$49
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Silicone Case with MagSafe — Black: US$49
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Wine Red: US$59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Taupe: US$59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Black: US$59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Wine Red: US$59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Black: US$59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Mulberry Purple: US$59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max Silicone Case with MagSafe — Black: US$49
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max Silicone Case with MagSafe — Magenta: US$49
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max Silicone Case with MagSafe — Wine Red: US$49

Featured pick: ESR

ESR's brand-new iPhone 18 Pro case and accessories range has officially launched, featuring premium colour craftsmanship and exclusive patented technology among its highlights. The star of the show is the new Atelier Vegan Leather magnetic case, with a built-in zinc alloy Flex Stand and camera bump protection, offering 3x military-grade protection, along with a "soft, flexible and comfortable grip." The Atelier new series, like the rest of the accessories, comes in four colourways that pair perfectly with the iPhone 18 Pro in Wine Red, Glacier, Black and Silver.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic Case with Flex Stand US$42 (original price US$46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector US$30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock Magnetic Case US$21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo Magnetic Wallet with Kickstand (and Grip) US$46 (original price US$50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

Nomad is arguably one of the top brands in the leather case world, and all of their flagship models are now available in iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max versions. Worth noting is that this year they've also added the Rugged Case series, with each colour incorporating topographic map patterns of the Baja California Peninsula:

  • Rugged Case US$70
  • Colours: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather US$69
  • Colours: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back US$59
  • Colours: Wine Red, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case US$55
  • Colours: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Gray
  • Modern Leather Case US$69 to US$89
  • Traditional Leather Case US$79 to US$99
  • Rugged Leather Case US$79
  • Colours: Rustic Brown

Featured pick: Dbrand

Dbrand is ready and has launched the classic Grip case for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. In addition to a sleek minimalist design and an incredibly grippy feel, this year once again it's compatible with a huge range of customisable skin wraps to match your personal style; and if you bundle it with a compatible Prism screen protector, there's an extra discount to be had.

  • Dbrand Grip Case for iPhone 18 Pro/Max US$55 — customisable, drop protection, ultra-grippy texture, crisp button response
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 for iPhone 18 Pro/Max 2-pack US$35 (US$5 off when bundled with a case) — easy install, auto-alignment, dust-free

This year Dbrand has also for the first time launched the new MNML brand case line, starting from US$39, focusing on ultra-minimalist aesthetics, more affordable pricing, MagSafe support, while retaining the brand's signature irresistibly crisp button feel.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case US$39 — available in Black, Navy Blue, Brown and Wine Red

Spigen

  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case for iPhone 17/18 Pro, Black: US$14 (original price US$18)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case for iPhone 17/18 Pro, Clear: US$13 (original price US$17)
  • Spigen Nano Pop MagFit Case for iPhone 17/18 Pro, Black: US$20 (original price US$22)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case for iPhone 17/18 Pro Max, Black: US$14 (original price US$18)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case for iPhone 17/18 Pro Max, Clear: US$13 (original price US$17)
  • Spigen Nano Pop MagFit Case for iPhone 17/18 Pro Max, Wine Red: US$21 (original price US$24)
  • Spigen Slim Armor MagFit Case for iPhone 17/18 Pro, Black: US$26 (original price US$50)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case for iPhone 17/18 Pro, Blue: US$19 (original price US$40)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case for iPhone 17/18 Pro Max, Black: US$19 (original price US$40)

SANDMARC

  • SANDMARC Pro Leather Case for iPhone 18 Pro US$54 (original price US$60) — enter discount code 9TO510 at checkout
  • SANDMARC Pro Leather Case for iPhone 18 Pro Max US$54 (original price US$60)

****Note: SANDMARC products traditionally only get discounted once per year... unless you use our exclusive discount code.

Bluebonnet

Bluebonnet is a small Texas-based shop specialising in exquisite full-grain leather cases with a plastic-free one-piece design and copper-plated metal buttons — every one a premium piece. We've also secured an exclusive 20% off for 9to5 readers on the new iPhone 18 Pro cases:

  • Minimalist Full-Grain Leather iPhone 18 Pro MagSafe Case US$63 (original price US$79) — enter discount code 9to5 at checkout

Luriax

  • The Signature Suede-like for iPhone 18 Pro US$107 (original price US$120) — enter discount code 9TO5 at checkout
  • The Modern Suede-like for iPhone 18 Pro US$62 (original price US$69)

Arc

The 2026 Arc Pulse aerospace-grade metal bumper case has officially launched, with new colour additions this year to pair with Apple's Glacier and Wine Red devices:

  • Matte Black — US$69.99
  • Polished Silver — US$89.99
  • Polished Graphite — US$99.99
  • Matte Light Blue — US$119.99
  • Matte Deep Red — US$119.99
  • Polished Gold — US$129.99
  • Black Titanium — US$299.99

MUJJO Troubadour

  • iPhone 18 Series Full Leather Case US$59
  • Colours: Black, Basalt, Obsidian Green, Tan, Terracotta
  • iPhone 18 Series Modular Case US$59
  • Detachable magnetic back panel design, switchable between two modes. With the panel attached: transforms into a full-grain leather case with a slim design and MagSafe support

Burton Goods

***Note: Use the exclusive discount code 9TO520 with the cases below for an extra 20% off the already-discounted launch price. If it doesn't work, try entering DUO10 at checkout.

  • Heritage Leather Case for iPhone 18 Pro/Max US$60 (original price US$80)
  • Luxury Pocket Book Wallet Case for iPhone 18 Pro/Max US$89 (original price US$119)
  • Heritage Leather Case For iPhone 18 Duo US$60 (original price US$80)

Alto Collective — Laser-Engraved Wood Grain

  • Alto Laser-Engraved Wood Grain iPhone 18 Pro Case from US$33 (10% off) — enter discount code 9TO5MAC at checkout Laser Engraved Series Retro Inlay Series Custom Image Upload

UAG

UAG has also launched multiple cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, including their signature rugged-style designs with chunky corner protection, anti-slip bezels and a range focused on drop protection. If you're after something tougher and more durable for everyday protection, UAG's lineup is well worth a look.

  • UAG Mouve US$65 — for iPhone Duo
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case US$80 — for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max
  • UAG Civilian Anti-Slip Case from US$60
  • And more...

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Case

If you want a rugged and durable case for your new iPhone but don't want to go with the usual suspects like OtterBox or UAG, consider YETI's LoadOut series. These cases have passed MIL-STD-810H drop testing, offer reliable protection, support MagSafe, and come with a built-in rotating kickstand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're after something more premium but not overly thick for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, don't miss Mous. Beyond the featured picks, there's also the ultra-thin Aramid Fibre carbon fibre case made specifically for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case US$75
  • Mous Clear Case US$70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fibre Carbon Fiber Case US$85
  • Mous Thin MagSafe Case US$55
  • Mous Thin Aramid Fibre Carbon Fiber Case US$70
  • And more...

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases take a bold design-forward approach, with a futuristic look, a slim profile, and a unique textured finish that really stands out from the crowd.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fiber Carbon Fibre Case US$66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop-Resistant Case US$60 — for iPhone 18 Pro
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case US$40

Pitaka

If you're after a slimmer case for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, PITAKA fits the bill. Their cases generally use lightweight Aramid carbon fibre material with a sleek minimalist look, while retaining MagSafe compatibility and adding extra protection around the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fibre Carbon Fibre Weave Case US$60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Aramid Carbon Fibre Drop-Resistant Case US$80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Protective Case US$60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox has also prepared a solid lineup of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, ranging from slim everyday options to tougher rugged designs for solid protection. The new models generally support MagSafe, with certain designs adding extras like anti-slip bezels, accessory storage, raised camera protection and built-in kickstands — so you can pick the thickness and protection level to suit your needs.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro US$70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series US$50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Kickstand US$60
  • OtterBox Sole Series US$60
  • And more...

Belkin

Belkin is another solid choice for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, especially for those who prefer a cleaner design without adding too much bulk. Their lineup mainly covers MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases with raised edges around the screen and camera, and certain models like the Protect+ add extra corner impact protection, striking a nice balance between everyday protection and slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case US$30
  • Belkin Qi2-compatible MagSafe Grip Case US$50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Airbag Corners US$60

CASETiFY

CASETiFY is always one of the first brands out of the gate with cases for new iPhones, and the iPhone 18 Pro lineup is already available with plenty of options. The brand is best known for colourful designs, bold prints, and protective cases that don't look overly rugged. The range broadly supports MagSafe, with clear, impact-resistant and fashion-forward styles all covered.

  • CASETiFY Ripple Silicone Case US$56
  • CASETiFY Impact Ring Stand Case US$64
  • CASETiFY Mirror Mirror Case with MagSafe US$64
  • And more...

Speck

Speck's iPhone 18 Pro lineup carries on the brand's signature style — clean design, focused on everyday protection. Many of the slim, grippy designs come in MagSafe-compatible versions and clear options that let the original device colour show through. These cases also offer solid drop protection without making the phone feel overly bulky.

  • Speck Presidio Clear Grip Case US$50 — for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
  • Speck Presidio 2 Grip ClickLock Case with MagSafe US$50
  • Speck CandyShell Icon Case with MagSafe US$40
  • And more...

elago

elago cases lean towards a clean, minimalist design language, with more affordable pricing than other brands. The lineup generally includes slim silicone, clear and MagSafe-compatible options in simple colourways that pair easily with Apple's various device finishes.

  • elago Urban Clear Case US$14 (original price US$16)
  • elago Pebble Case US$15 (original price US$17)
  • elago Ring Stand Armor Case US$19 (original price US$25)
  • elago Ridge Silicone Case US$19
  • And more...

Screen protectors

  • ZAGG Glass Elite Screen Protector for iPhone 18 Pro US$40
  • TORRAS OrigArmor for iPhone 18 Pro US$35
  • Ailun Screen Protector for iPhone 18 Pro 3-pack US$7
  • ESR Armorite Pro Tempered Glass Screen Protector (2-pack) US$30
  • Spigen GlasTR EZ FIT Screen Protector US$20
  • CASETiFY Anti-Blue Light Screen Protector US$38
